description: Source code for a SQL query compiler module in Rust, including expression compilation, error handling, and query structure definitions.

classes.name: CompilationError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible compilation errors during query compilation.

classes.name: CompilationInput
classes.description: Trait for providing datapoint types for compilation.

classes.name: CompilationInputImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CompilationInput trait, holding schema data.

classes.name: CompiledQuery
classes.description: Represents a compiled SQL query with selection, projection, input specifications, and subqueries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CompilationInputImpl or CompiledQuery.

methods.name: add_entry
methods.description: Adds a datapoint name and type to the schema in CompilationInputImpl.

methods.name: get_datapoint_type
methods.description: Retrieves the data type for a given datapoint name.

methods.name: compile_expr
methods.description: Compiles a SQL AST expression into an internal Expr representation, resolving literals, identifiers, functions, and operators.

methods.name: resolve_literal
methods.description: Resolves unresolved literals to typed literals based on the expected DataType.

methods.name: compile_select_statement
methods.description: Compiles a SQL SELECT statement AST into a internal CompiledQuery structure.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main function to parse SQL string and compile it into a query structure.
